faqs.a: A way for a small business to get its own small AI model for one job, like sorting support tickets or reading invoices. Idle gaming PCs and laptops do the training, and you pay only if the model passes your test.

faqs.q: How much data do I need?
faqs.a: Between 20 and 50 examples of the right answer. Some are kept aside, unseen, to test the model before you pay.
Hindi, Hinglish and English. Two of the first five jobs, support tickets and clinic questions, are built around Hinglish.

faqs.q: What if the model isn't good enough?
faqs.a: Then you don't pay. It has to pass your test and beat the untrained model; if it misses either, the whole budget is refunded automatically.

faqs.q: Can I use it for my business today?
faqs.a: Not yet for real money. Ekido runs on a public test network with test money until an independent audit.
